iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: BBC frames the atomic challenge as central while Reuters and CFR report a U.S.-Iran accord may be close. Unresolved 60 percent stockpiles and inspection access keep the nuclear file imminent, but active deal momentum lowers near-term risk.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR
iran_conventional.notes: Reuters, Washington Post, AP and DW report a U.S.-Iran accord or ceasefire framework may be close and Trump paused new strike threats. Conventional risk remains imminent while regional forces stay on alert, but the direction is easing.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: BBC, Al Jazeera and Haaretz report Israeli air activity in Lebanon, forced-displacement orders, casualties, and Hezbollah fire/drone response while truce language circulates. The local escalation track is still rising despite regional deal talk.

turkey.name: TURKEY-NATO
turkey.notes: Turkey coverage is mostly political and economic: Erdogan warned of costs from Iran attacks and NATO/Ankara diplomacy continued. No fresh Turkey-NATO military trigger surfaced.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: AnewZ reports Pakistan warning that Indian river-flow restrictions could be an act of war. Rhetoric is sharper, but no fresh large border clash or force surge was verified in this scan.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Current Russia-NATO search returned weak direct-clash material only. The track remains critical because of Ukraine spillover and prior deterrence signaling, but no fresh Article 5 or direct NATO-Russia combat trigger was verified.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: Asahi/Reuters-linked reporting says Taiwan drilled coastal defense, ISW issued its China-Taiwan update, and regional feeds reported 27 PRC military vessels around Taiwan. Pressure rose modestly, with no blockade trigger confirmed.

north_korea.name: DPRK
north_korea.notes: Regional feeds report a new plant tied to fissile-material production and Xi-Kim alignment rhetoric, including omission of denuclearization language. This raises background risk, but no fresh projectile flight event or atomic detonation event was verified.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Anadolu reports a Zaporizhzhia nuclear-plant workshop attack claim; DW reported off-site power cut and later IAEA-linked reporting said the plant was reconnected. War intensity and nuclear-safety risk remain extreme.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: News On AIR, DD News, open.kg and MSN-linked feeds report Pakistan-Afghanistan clashes, Pakistan airstrikes on Afghan territory, and casualty claims. The border-war track is moving higher.

sudan.name: SUDAN
sudan.notes: Al Jazeera and Sudanese sources report RSF-attributed drone strikes around el-Obeid killing up to 23 and hitting residential/funeral/food-supply targets; Kordofan drone war is widening.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE
israel_palestine.notes: Gaza strikes and deaths continued as Cairo-hosted ceasefire talks proceeded. The track remains imminent but not rising because diplomacy is active.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN-ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: No new credible 24h Abyei/South Sudan escalation found; older peacekeeper/clash items remain background only.

latest_news.headline: U.S.-Iran accord reported close
latest_news.text: Reuters, Washington Post, AP and DW report Washington and Tehran may be close to a ceasefire or accord framework; Trump paused new strike threats. This lowers immediate conventional-war risk but does not normalize forces yet.

latest_news.headline: Atomic file remains core obstacle
latest_news.text: BBC says the atomic challenge is central to Trump-Iran talks, while Reuters says a deal may be close. Existing 60 percent enrichment and inspection disputes keep the nuclear track imminent but falling.

latest_news.headline: Israel hits south Lebanon; Hezbollah responds
latest_news.text: BBC, Al Jazeera and Haaretz report Israeli air activity in south Lebanon, forced-displacement orders, five deaths, and Hezbollah drone/fire response. Local escalation rises even as regional truce language circulates.

latest_news.headline: Zaporizhzhia nuclear-safety pressure persists
latest_news.text: Anadolu reported a Zaporizhzhia plant workshop attack claim; DW reported off-site power disruption, and later IAEA-linked reporting said the plant was reconnected. Nuclear-safety risk remains high.

latest_news.headline: Pakistan-Afghanistan clashes and airstrikes continue
latest_news.text: News On AIR, DD News, open.kg and MSN-linked feeds report border clashes, Pakistan airstrikes on Afghan territory, and casualty claims. Escalation risk rises.

latest_news.headline: Taiwan drills as PRC military presence reported
latest_news.text: Asahi/Reuters-linked reporting says Taiwan simulated coastal defense; ISW updated China-Taiwan pressure, and regional feeds reported 27 Chinese military vessels near Taiwan. Risk edges higher without blockade confirmation.
